projectDescription: A Kubernetes CRD controller that automates the lifecycle management of CNCF Flux CD, providing GitOps autopilot with self-service environments, deployment windows, a Web UI, and an AI-powered MCP server.
keyFeatures: Automated Flux CD lifecycle management via FluxInstance CRD
Self-service environments with ResourceSet and ResourceSetInputProvider APIs
GitHub/GitLab/Azure DevOps pull request ephemeral environments
Flux Web UI with real-time GitOps pipeline visualization
AI-powered MCP Server for natural language cluster operations
Time-based deployment windows with cron scheduling
Prometheus metrics and deep reporting via FluxReport CRD
Enterprise distribution support with SLSA Level 3 supply chain security
OCI, S3, and Git-based cluster sync sources
publicApiSurface: flux-operator CLI (install, uninstall, build, diff, patch, get, reconcile, suspend, resume, delete, export, stats, trace, tree, wait, create secret, skills, distro)

flux-operator-mcp (MCP tools: get_flux_instance, get_kubernetes_resources, get_kubernetes_logs, get_kubernetes_metrics, get_kubernetes_api_versions, get_kubeconfig_contexts, set_kubeconfig_context, reconcile_flux_source, reconcile_flux_kustomization, reconcile_flux_helmrelease, reconcile_flux_resourceset, suspend_flux_reconciliation, resume_flux_reconciliation, apply_kubernetes_manifest, delete_kubernetes_resource, install_flux_instance, search_flux_docs)
Prometheus metrics: flux_instance_info, flux_resource_info, flux_resourceset_info, flux_resourcesetinputprovider_info
